findings.claim: 自2025年2月起CAH已支付約2億美元IEEPA關稅，主要在GMPD部門；最高法院2026年2月裁定IEEPA關稅違法。
findings.excerpt: Since February 2025, we have paid approximately $200 million in IEEPA tariffs, related to products that we source, manufacture or distribute, primarily in our GMPD segment.

findings.claim: FY26 Q4認列約2億美元IEEPA關稅退款應收款，並預期把相應部分退還客戶；淨營業利益影響約1億美元（Q4），全年不重大。
findings.excerpt: During the fourth quarter of fiscal 2026, we recorded a receivable of approximately $200 million in relation to the expected refund of IEEPA tariffs from the U.S. Government.

findings.claim: GMPD持續承受Section 122/232/301及Smoot-Hawley 308關稅帶來的成本增加，調價未能完全抵銷。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2026 MD&A Tariff Environment
findings.excerpt: our GMPD segment has experienced, and expects to continue to experience increased costs as a result of tariffs imposed or expected to be imposed under different legal authority, including Sections 122, 232 and 301 of the Trade Act of 1974 and Section 308 of the Smoot-Hawley Tariff Act.

findings.claim: 2026年4月總統公告對品牌藥及相關原料進口課關稅，Pharma部門可能受影響。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2026 MD&A Tariff Environment
findings.excerpt: An April 2026 proclamation issued by the President of the United States imposed tariffs on imports of branded pharmaceutical products and associated ingredients imported into the United States.

findings.claim: 總統聲明學名藥2028年起課100%、2029年起課200%關稅，實施仍高度不確定，可能影響Pharma部門成本或供給。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2026 MD&A Tariff Environment
findings.excerpt: the President recently issued a statement indicating that generic pharmaceutical products will be subject to 100% tariffs beginning in 2028 and 200% tariffs beginning in 2029.

reg_tariff_export.note: 出口管制／實體清單未另行搜尋；10-K摘錄未提及出口管制。
